description.content: Close every popout window (without moving their tabs back to the main workspace).
Each popout window's current model and where it is on screen, e.g. to save them (and open them again later with open).
A popup that reports the opener's exact position as its own (e.g. in Brave) is reported where it was opened instead.
Open a popout window showing a model (e.g. from a button that pops out a tab, or to restore a saved popout).
Browsers block popup windows that aren't opened in response to user input (e.g. a click), and some block all but the first one opened for each input.
Render the popout windows' content (each into its window's container, with a portal); render the result alongside the main Workspace.

fields.name: render
fields.type: (renderWorkspace: (props: PopoutWorkspaceProps<TabData, TabsetData>, popout: PopoutWindow) => ReactNode) => ReactNode
